_comment: Copy to research/interests.json and edit. Used by the paper-researcher agent and the weekly routine. Only interests.json (not your notes) needs committing if you run the Cloud Routine.
own_work: Describe your projects/interests in 2-4 sentences so the agent can judge a paper's relevance to YOU — e.g. 'I build tabular ML pipelines for churn and pricing at a fintech; I care about leakage-safe evaluation, calibration, and model monitoring; less interested in pure NLP/vision unless it transfers to tabular.'
